reference_sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
  -- one row per order placed in March 2025 (UTC days of order_ts) holding 2 or more units: added up before the join
  SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur - line_discount_eur) AS revenue
  FROM order_lines
  WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00')
  GROUP BY order_id
  HAVING SUM(quantity) >= 2
)
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS big_orders, SUM(t.revenue) AS revenue
FROM order_totals t
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code

)

solver.query:
WITH ou AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id, SUM(l.quantity) AS units,
    SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur) AS rev
  FROM orders o JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.store_id
  HAVING SUM(l.quantity) >= 2
)
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS big_orders, SUM(ou.rev) AS revenue
FROM ou JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = ou.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code
